ui.onb.1.head: Your Aloni
ui.onb.1.body: One place for your fields, crops and crates. It works without signal.
ui.onb.2.head: Demo farm = made-up data
ui.onb.2.body: Try everything in the demo farm. It never touches your real data.
ui.onb.3.head: The app suggests; you decide
ui.onb.3.body: It never picks a product or a dose and never shortens a waiting period. The product label is the law.
ui.share.title: Picture to share
ui.share.privacy: The picture has no worker or field names, location, spraying, product or price. You tap share yourself.
ui.share.failed: The picture could not be made on this phone.
ui.sheet.notfound.head: Not found
ui.sheet.notfound.body: This page no longer exists or its data is missing.
ui.sheet.crates.none: Unknown: no harvest was logged in this period. The total is not zero, it is unknown.
ui.sheet.crates.unreadable: {n} entries with an unreadable crate count. They are not added to the total.
ui.sheet.cut.none: Nothing to cut: no planting was found in the fields.
ui.sheet.cut.free.why: The recorded, signed label says the waiting period is over.
ui.sheet.cut.wait.why: Sprayed and the waiting period is running. The end date is beside it.
ui.sheet.cut.unknown.why: A signed label or the waiting value is missing. It does not count as free.
ui.sheet.crop.target.none: no target set: set a target
ui.wait.unknown.why: A signed label (or the waiting value) for this crop is missing. There is no ring and it does not count as free.
ui.wait.noring: The dates cannot be read, so there is no ring.
ui.wait.source.label: product label (signed)
ui.wait.note: From the recorded data. The product label is the law; the app never shortens a waiting period.
ui.weather.issued.unknown: unknown: no issue time is written
ui.weather.hourly.why: not on the phone: the server keeps daily values only here
ui.weather.none.why: No stored weather: no field has a location or the forecast has not been fetched yet. Give a field a location.
ui.jobs.none: No jobs: neither open nor done today.
ui.quick.title: Quick add
ui.quick.observe.error: Choose a field and what you saw.
ui.bell.label: Notifications
ui.bell.title: What is new
ui.bell.none: Nothing new since you last looked.
ui.refused.title: Why it was not accepted
ui.refused.none: The server's answer for this record is no longer here. The record is still on the phone.
ui.invite.title: Worker invitation
ui.invite.qr.alt: QR code with the invitation link
ui.invite.qr.none: The link is too long for a QR code. Use the link.
ui.invite.copy.failed: Not copied. Press and hold the link and choose «Copy».
ui.invite.step1: Opens the link, or scans the QR code with the phone camera.
ui.invite.step2: Types the email you sent the invitation to.
ui.invite.step3: Types the 6-digit code that arrives in the email.
ui.invite.note: The link does not give access by itself: first send an invitation to the worker's email (above). The link contains only the language.
ui.target.unreadable: {n} harvest records cannot be read and were not added.
ui.target.nodata.why: There is no readable harvest record for this crop since {d}: no percent is shown.
ui.target.err.crates: Write a whole number of crates above 0.
ui.target.local: The target is kept on this phone only; it is not sent to the server yet.
ui.account.title: Delete account
ui.account.intro: Here you see what is deleted, what is kept and why.
ui.account.worker.title: When a worker leaves
ui.account.worker.body: You switch the worker off in «Workers» and their sign-in stops. Their e-mail is deleted and their name is replaced by «Former worker 1». The sprayings and harvests they recorded stay for 3 years (a legal duty) and show only that pseudonym. This step on the server will be switched on before the start.
ui.account.owner.title: When you leave
ui.account.owner.body: First you download the backup file and the spray register. Spray and harvest records must be kept for at least 3 years: the file you download is your own copy. Whatever is not held by a duty is deleted.
ui.account.server.title: Account on the server
ui.account.server.on: Sync is on: your data also exists on the server. Deleting it there is not yet available inside the app; it will be switched on before the start.
ui.account.server.off: Sync is not on: nothing has been sent to the server. The data is only on this phone.
ui.account.phone.title: Delete from this phone
ui.account.phone.body: All the data on this device is deleted: fields, plantings, sprayings, harvests, photos and settings. It cannot be undone.
ui.account.demo: There is nothing to delete in the Demo: the data is made up.
ui.account.backup.done: The backup was downloaded. Keep it: it is your own copy of the records.
ui.account.why.phrase: Type the name exactly to open the button.
ui.account.why.backup: Make a backup first (valid for 15 minutes).
ui.account.why.unsent: {n} records have not been sent to the server yet. Wait for them to be sent.
ui.info.privacy.photos: Photos: every photo is re-written as a JPEG before it is stored, so the location (GPS) and other camera details are lost. A photo that cannot be read is not stored. It stays with the record as evidence of the field until it is deleted.
ui.job.spray.made: A record was made for this job
ui.job.spray.none: There is no spray record for this job yet.
ui.job.harvests: Harvests on the same plantings since then
ui.job.harvests.none: No harvest has been logged since the job's day.
ui.job.crates.unknown: unknown: the number cannot be read
ui.diag.title: Error report
ui.diag.note: If the app has an error it keeps it only on this phone. Nothing is sent automatically. You can copy the report and send it yourself.
ui.diag.count: {n} errors were recorded on this phone.
ui.diag.copied: The report was copied. It contains nothing about the farm.
ui.diag.copy.failed: Not copied. Press and hold the text and choose «Copy».
ui.install.card: Put Aloni on the Home Screen
ui.install.title: Add to the Home Screen
ui.install.step1: Open Aloni in Safari (not inside another app).
ui.install.step2: Tap the «Share» button at the bottom of Safari.
ui.install.step3: Scroll and tap «Add to Home Screen».
ui.install.step5: From now on open Aloni from the icon on the Home Screen.
ui.install.warning: Careful: Safari and the Home Screen app keep SEPARATE data. Install BEFORE you record data. If you already recorded in Safari, first make a data copy (Άλλα → Data copy) and restore it inside the Home Screen app.
ui.news.title: What is new
ui.news.r1.a: Σήμερα has a bell with what is new, a «＋» button for quick entry, and a page that shows where every number comes from.
ui.news.r1.b: Every record shows whether it is only on the phone, was sent, or was not accepted by the server, and why.
ui.news.r1.c: Worker invitation with a QR code and a link, an iPhone Home Screen guide, and an error report that stays on the phone.
ui.product.general.fungicide: Fungicides are products that relate to fungal diseases of plants.
ui.product.general.insecticide: Insecticides are products that relate to insects that harm plants.
ui.product.general.herbicide: Herbicides are products that relate to weeds.
ui.product.general.fertiliser: Fertilisers are products that add nutrients to the soil or the plant.
ui.product.general.other: There is no general description for this type.
ui.product.general.note: What is allowed, and how, is set only by the product label.

ui.info.privacy.contacts: Contacts: if you record customers, worker cards or a receiver of a direct dispatch, the name, phone and notes are stored. Only the owner sees them, never the workers. Today they stay on this phone only; nothing is sent until sync is on and the matching server table exists. There is no date of birth. They are deleted when asked, unless the law requires keeping them. Spray and harvest records are kept at least 3 years.
